rationale: Direct regulatory and company evidence supports Intermountain Infrastructure Group, LLC as a U.S.-canonical fiber owner/operator under Intermountain Holdings LLC. The January 12, 2024 recapitalization brought Wafra and Post Road vehicles into the ownership structure. Current June 2026 company evidence names Wafra as majority shareholder and Future Standard as Post Road's successor institutional backer. Canada is a secondary footprint, all named routes remain beneath the one IIG platform, and no IIG-level realized or signed pending exit was found through August 19, 2026.

Jeffrey Yount's current residual percentage and any other founder interests are not publicly disclosed.
